class.name: VideoWindowSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for windows and display: mode, size, screen, V-Sync, content scale and HDR.

method.name: clear_window_state
method.description: Removes the stored state of the window with this key (its node path or the key passed to [method save_window_state]).

method.name: get_command_line_options
method.description: Returns the window options passed on the command line, which the engine consumes before scripts run. Possible keys: [code]window_mode[/code], [code]window_size[/code], [code]screen[/code], [code]window_position[/code], [code]always_on_top[/code], [code]vsync_mode[/code] and [code]embedded[/code] (the game runs embedded in the editor). Only the options that were given are present.

method.name: place_main_window
method.description: Places the main window on [member VideoWindowSettings.screen] (or on the primary screen if it does not exist) and, in windowed mode, at [member VideoWindowSettings.window_position] or centered, always inside the usable area of the screen. Called when the game starts and when one of these values changes; call it after a change of the monitors to bring the window back. Does nothing without free windows.

method.name: restore_window_state
method.description: Gives [param window] the stored mode, size and position. The key is the node path of the window, or [param key] if it is not empty (needed for a window that is not in the scene tree yet). A stored screen that does not exist is replaced by the primary screen, and the window is kept inside the usable area of the screen. Returns [code]false[/code] if no state is stored for the key.

method.name: save_window_state
method.description: Stores the mode, size, position and screen of [param window] in [member VideoWindowSettings.window_states] under its node path, or under [param key] if it is not empty. Windows with a stored state get it back when they enter the scene tree. The state is saved like any other value (autosave or [method SettingsServer.save]).

method.name: set_always_on_top
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.always_on_top]. If [code]true[/code], the main window stays above other windows ([constant DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_ALWAYS_ON_TOP]). The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/size/always_on_top].

method.name: set_borderless
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.borderless]. If [code]true[/code], the main window has no title bar and no border ([constant DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_BORDERLESS]). The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/size/borderless].

method.name: set_content_scale_aspect
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.content_scale_aspect]. How the root window keeps the aspect ratio of the game when it is scaled ([member Window.content_scale_aspect]). The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/stretch/aspect]. Applied when the root window exists.

method.name: set_content_scale_factor
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.content_scale_factor]. Scale factor of the root window ([member Window.content_scale_factor]). The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/stretch/scale]. Values below [code]0.1[/code] are clamped. The root window gets this factor times [member AccessibilitySettings.ui_scale] of [AccessibilitySettingsServer], the player's UI scale option.

method.name: set_content_scale_mode
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.content_scale_mode]. How the root window scales the game to the window size ([member Window.content_scale_mode]). The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/stretch/mode].

method.name: set_content_scale_stretch
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.content_scale_stretch]. Whether the root window scales by fractional or by integer factors ([member Window.content_scale_stretch]). The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/stretch/scale_mode].

method.name: set_hdr_max_luminance
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.hdr_max_luminance]. Maximum luminance in nits for HDR output of the main window ([method DisplayServer.window_set_hdr_output_max_luminance]). [code]-1.0[/code] (the default) uses the value of the screen; negative values become [code]-1.0[/code].

method.name: set_hdr_output_requested
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.hdr_output_requested]. If [code]true[/code], the main window requests HDR output ([member Window.hdr_output_requested]). The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/hdr/request_hdr_output]. Applied in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_PHASE_SCENE], after the project value. Whether HDR is used depends on the platform, the driver and the screen; see [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported].

method.name: set_hdr_reference_luminance
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.hdr_reference_luminance]. Reference (paper white) luminance in nits for HDR output of the main window ([method DisplayServer.window_set_hdr_output_reference_luminance]). [code]-1.0[/code] (the default) uses the value of the screen; negative values become [code]-1.0[/code].

method.name: set_screen
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.screen]. The screen of the main window, an index from [code]0[/code] to [method DisplayServer.get_screen_count] minus one, or [constant DisplayServer.SCREEN_PRIMARY] (the default). If the screen does not exist when the window is placed (for example a monitor that was unplugged), the primary screen is used and the stored value stays. Values below [code]-2[/code] are clamped. Changes go through the confirmation (see [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation]).

method.name: set_transparent
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.transparent]. If [code]true[/code], the main window has a transparent background ([constant DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_TRANSPARENT]). Only applied if [member ProjectSettings.display/window/per_pixel_transparency/allowed] is enabled; the default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/size/transparent].

method.name: set_unresizable
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.unresizable]. If [code]true[/code], the player can't resize the main window ([constant DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_RESIZE_DISABLED]). The default is the opposite of [member ProjectSettings.display/window/size/resizable].

method.name: set_vsync_mode
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.vsync_mode]. The V-Sync mode of the main window ([method DisplayServer.window_set_vsync_mode]). The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/vsync/vsync_mode]. The command line argument [code]--disable-vsync[/code] overrides it for the session.

method.name: set_window_centered
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.window_centered]. If [code]true[/code] (the default), the main window is centered in the usable area of its [member VideoWindowSettings.screen] in windowed mode, and [member VideoWindowSettings.window_position] is ignored.

method.name: set_window_mode
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.window_mode]. The mode of the main window: windowed, maximized, fullscreen or exclusive fullscreen. The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/size/mode]. The main window is created in this mode, so there is no visible change when the game starts. Changes go through the confirmation (see [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation]). The command line arguments [code]--fullscreen[/code], [code]--maximized[/code] and [code]--windowed[/code] override it for the session.

method.name: set_window_position
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.window_position]. Position of the main window in windowed mode, relative to the top-left corner of its [member VideoWindowSettings.screen]. Only used if [member VideoWindowSettings.window_centered] is [code]false[/code]. The window is always moved back into the usable area of the screen, so it stays visible after a change of the monitors.

method.name: set_window_size
method.description: Sets [member VideoWindowSettings.window_size]. Size of the main window in windowed mode, in pixels. The default is [member ProjectSettings.display/window/size/viewport_width] and [member ProjectSettings.display/window/size/viewport_height] (or the window size overrides). The size is kept while the window is maximized or fullscreen and used again when it is windowed. It is limited to the usable area of the screen. Changes go through the confirmation (see [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation]). The command line argument [code]--resolution[/code] overrides it for the session.

signal.name: borderless_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member VideoWindowSettings.borderless] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.

signal.name: window_mode_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member VideoWindowSettings.window_mode] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to update the options menu or the mouse mode. A mode that needs a confirmation fires when it is applied and again with the old mode if the confirmation is canceled.
